reply.shortGloss: to catch; to grab; to hold
reply.emotion: focused and determined, reaching out with purpose
notes: Use 잡다 when you physically grab or catch something moving, or when you hold an object in your hand.
It is also used abstractly for planning a schedule or setting a date (like 날짜를 잡다).

senses.definition: To take something moving in your hands or catch an animal or object.

examples.emotion: excited and proud of the successful catch

senses.definition: To hold something firmly with the hand.

examples.translation: Hold firmly onto the bus handle.
examples.emotion: serious and cautious, warning someone to stay safe

definitions: To take something moving in your hands or catch an animal or object.
To hold something firmly with the hand.
